'''Teth''' was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Teth (star)|star]] of the same name and had two moons that orbited the planet itself. It was located within the [[Teth system/Legends|Teth system]] of the [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]] in the outer border of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that crossed over into the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region.

==History==
Once a prominent vacation world for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], Teth suffered an economic crisis when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] began to crack down upon the criminals housed on-planet. Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] helped local [[Constable/Legends|constable]] [[Janu Godalhi/Legends|Janu Godalhi]] capture [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] as part of the Republic crackdown, further driving the Hutts out.

===The Clone Wars===
[[File:Teth_moons.png|thumb|left|250px|The moons of Teth]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was home to [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] agents who'd kidnapped [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], son of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], concealing themselves within a [[B'omarr Monastery]]-turned-fortress on a [[Wikipedia:mesa|mesa]]. The monastery soon found itself the site of a [[Battle of Teth/Legends|large battle]] between Republic and Separatist forces. The battle raged up the mesa's cliff side, in which the Republic's primary weapon were standard [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] Walkers, which were used to climb up to the fortress. Upon reaching the top, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] recovered the missing Huttlet. Later, Skywalker and Tano found the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] on an adjacent cliff, and used it to transport Rotta back to his father on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

Later in the war, [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the Hutt visited his [[Papa/Legends|father's]] [[Tomb of Ziro the Hutt's father/Legends|hidden grave]], located on the planet. He used the site to hide a holo-journal containing information about the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council's]] illegal dealings. As he recovered the journal, Ziro was betrayed by his girlfriend [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]], who shot him dead and took the journal to Jabba, her employer.

===Under the New Order===
Having ridden itself from the criminal gangs and mercenaries due to the efforts of its local constabulary and the Republic, Teth became the capital of the [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]] under the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and control was given to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Sarn Shild]]. The Empire built the capital [[Peroon]], a naval base and small shipyard, and made the planet an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]]. Teth gave the Empire nominal control of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and created a bulwark against the Hutts' schemes.<ref name="TEA" />

The Hutts, however, reacted with investments, threats and bribery and created a criminal underground on the planet, exploiting a portion of the harvest income.<ref name="TEA" />

===Galactic Civil War===
Moff Shild later used the planet as the marshaling point for his fleet before he launched his [[Battle of Nar Shaddaa (4 BBY)|attack]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]].

It was also the location of an early [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cell. It was considered a significant investment, as the Corellian Rebels were willing to risk sending the valued commander [[Bria Tharen]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to make contact with them. The Tethan Rebels declined to join an outright alliance, but were willing to increase their attacks on Imperial targets like supply dumps and ships coming to and from the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and help funnel the proceeds to their Core-ward brethren.

After the Empire's fall, the Hutts returned to the planet, which by then had been made richer by the Empire's influence.<ref name="TEA" />
